checks: IFC schema parse and expected IFC4 file header.
Project length/area/volume units equal declared inputs.
Every wall has a unique GlobalId and storey containment; each opening has a unique GlobalId and expected representation.
`IfcRelVoidsElement` connects each opening to exactly its host wall; opening/wall local transforms agree.
Bonsai/IfcConvert independent reopen; compare bounds, volume, orientation and IDs.
Registration controls vs held-out control residuals, in local regions and units.
COLMAP camera reprojection and depth/photogrammetry overlap; metric scale only with source controls.
failure_recovery: Plan scale or north conflict: keep input unchanged; fix the calibration record, regenerate a new IFC path and compare reports.
Missing openings or invalid IFC feature relation: inspect per-wall opening dimensions and rerun against new target, not the old file.
COLMAP disconnected camera clusters: separate reconstruction components, add overlap images or supply known camera poses; do not merge by visual guess.
ICP drift: return to survey control correspondences and global registration; do not accept local RMSE alone.
Low memory: reduce image resolution/patch source count or omit MVS; keep the sparse camera solve and label result as surface-incomplete.

effort.human_reason: Plan interpretation, element classification, multi-source registration and georeferencing require expert decisions. IFC-only from an already vectorized/dimensioned plan is substantially easier.
effort.setup_reason: Combines IFC authoring, camera solve/MVS, point-cloud registration, model licensing and geometry/display adapters.
effort.compute_reason: Sparse reconstruction and IFC creation are CPU/modest; dense multi-view stereo, multiple image batches and large point clouds dominate. DOM contract rates the complete plan+survey+registered IFC path.

resources.cpu: CPU for API/IFC parsing and controls; multithreading for geometry/reconstruction.
resources.gpu: COLMAP dense PatchMatch benefits from CUDA-capable GPU; CPU-only feature/matching path exists; depth registration can remain CPU.
resources.ram: IFC graph size, raster dimensions, number of cameras, dense depth maps and point count drive RAM.
resources.storage: Original images/depth frames, SfM database, dense depth maps, clouds, IFC and display derivatives; preserve separate source and output trees.
scaling_drivers: mesh/cloud points and IFC element count
stored copies of intermediate depth maps
variants: Vectorized plan and no survey MVS lower effort and compute.
Photos without control points yield reconstruction with arbitrary scale.
Depth frames calibrated to survey frame reduce SfM workload.
BIM semantics remain human-authored even with high-quality surfaces.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Raster floor plan to IFC building
prerequisites: Known plan scale/control lengths, orientation, floor elevation and interpretation rules for walls/openings.
preserves: Original raster, scale transform, interpreted linework, dimension sources and uncertain regions.
changes_or_infers: Pixels interpreted as boundaries and building elements; semantic classification is human/model inference.
checks: Wall thickness, openings, elevations, spatial containment, area/element checks and IFC validation.
alternatives: Vector drawing to sketch if original CAD exists; manual IFC authoring for high-confidence boundaries.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Build semantic IFC from a raster plan, normalized building brief, dimensions, measured controls and licensed component sources; document scale, axes, elevations and interpretation decisions.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Photos/video to camera solution, point cloud and mesh
prerequisites: Overlapping sharp views, camera metadata/calibration where available, scene motion/lighting assessed and scale controls identified.
preserves: Original frames, camera solution, control points, reconstruction settings, sparse/dense outputs.
changes_or_infers: Videos sampled into images; camera poses and dense surfaces are estimated from image correspondences.
checks: Registered-view coverage, reprojection residuals, independent scale distances, surface holes and withheld checks.
alternatives: RGB-D/LiDAR for metric depth; single-image learned mesh only for visual proposal.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Reconstruct visible geometry and camera poses from image sequences; monocular scale requires external controls.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Depth frames to registered point cloud or mesh
prerequisites: Sensor model, calibration, units, extrinsics and depth validity/range known.
preserves: Raw depth/color, frame timestamps, sensor coordinates and transforms.
changes_or_infers: Registration, filtering and surface fusion combine depth samples into new geometry.
checks: Loop closure, registration residual, independent lengths, depth noise and coverage.
alternatives: Photogrammetry for passive optical scenes; per-frame point cloud where fusion is inappropriate.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Fuse calibrated depth observations into metric geometry while retaining the raw sensor frames.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Register scan to building frame
tools: COLMAP/AliceVision; Open3D/CloudCompare; IFC geometry as reference
prerequisites: At least one common frame datum and distributed control points/lengths; scan sensor calibration available.
preserves: Raw images/depth, capture settings, raw reconstruction and all transforms.
changes_or_infers: Aligns the scan to IFC coordinates; registration adjusts pose/scale, not building semantics.
checks: Registration residuals and held-out distances; check local regions separately and flag occlusion.
alternatives: Surveyed control transformation; ICP refinement after coarse frame alignment.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Register the scan point cloud to the IFC/building frame using measured controls; output the transform and aligned point cloud. Camera poses are not created unless camera observations are supplied.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Extract IFC geometry as triangles
prerequisites: IFC schema and length units read; target representation chosen.
preserves: IFC source, GlobalId/entity map, item/material IDs and object placement.
changes_or_infers: Geometry API can emit tessellated triangles or OpenCASCADE B-rep; extraction is a derived geometry view.
checks: Element ID mapping, bounds, face/solid count, volume and units against source; relationships remain in IFC.
alternatives: Triangulation for display/clash; B-rep where analytic editing/surface inspection is required.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Extract IFC geometry as tessellated triangles and retain its element mapping.

registered_operation_sequence.name: IFC to GLB display scene
prerequisites: Element-to-display mapping and length/orientation conversion are declared.
preserves: IFC source/hash; stable element IDs; source properties in sidecar mapping where GLB cannot retain them.
changes_or_infers: BIM objects become render nodes/meshes; semantic/relationship data may be reduced or remapped.
checks: ID-to-node coverage, bounds, orientation, selected geometry hashes or residuals, output hashes.
alternatives: Use IFC-native viewer when BIM relationships/properties are the primary task.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Create a visual GLB derivative with provenance and object mapping, not a replacement IFC.

steps.action: Inspect original STEP header, vendor part identity, unit, assembly/product structure and terms; hash original file.

steps.action: Define part placement, parent link and joint explicitly from measurement/model brief.
steps.command_or_api: Author grounded/fixed/revolute/slider relation with its origin/axis/limits; for one part, create a declared robot link and attachment joint.

steps.action: Prepare separate visual and collision mesh assets with local frame and manifest.

steps.check: Overlay mesh with CAD; compare dimensions/bounds; inspect bores, gaps and clearances.

steps.action: Use manufacturer/test mass properties where available; otherwise calculate only with a sourced material density and validated solid volume.

steps.check: Check tensor symmetry/positive-definiteness and independent mass evidence; calculate relative to named link frame.

checks: STEP file revision/hash and units.
CAD import bounds, mass/volume and mounting dimensions against vendor drawing/measurement.
Joint graph tree and axis/origin/limit source.
URDF parses; every relative mesh path resolves; joint transforms match FreeCAD assembly.
Inertial values are sourced, framed and pass numerical tensor checks.
Visual and collision files are separate and generated from the same source revision.
Asset redistribution terms are attached to file; packaging does not silently relicense vendor geometry.
failure_recovery: STEP importer fails or units wrong: keep original, inspect AP schema/units and import in independent kernel before conversion.
No usable mass/inertia: preserve unknown fields as unknown; do not use arbitrary geometry density.
Mounting axis ambiguous: request measured datum or author an explicit design datum; do not fit it visually.
URDF importer rejects joint type or loop: use a documented tree adapter or native MJCF with explicit constraint topology.
Collision creates false contact: go back to visual CAD; split per-link collision bodies or choose primitives using contact needs.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Import STEP solid into CAD representation
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Import a supplied neutral STEP file to the project CAD representation; a faceted STEP source remains faceted after import. **Exact adapter fidelity depends on importer.**
prerequisites: Source schema, units and assembly structure are inspected before import/export.
preserves: Original STEP bytes and provenance; imported product identity and placement where available.
changes_or_infers: Import creates a CAD representation; export creates a neutral exchange file that may lose native history.
checks: Reopen in independent consumer; compare bounds/volume/part count and known interfaces.
alternatives: Use the receiving CAD application’s native STEP importer and preserve the source STEP file.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Library asset intake and rights record
tools: component registry/schema proposal; source license review
prerequisites: Original source identity and item-level license/terms available or explicitly unknown.
preserves: Original file, URL, retrieved date, hash, attribution, license text/terms and source claims.
changes_or_infers: Normalize metadata; derived conversions become separate assets with lineage.
checks: License status per file; duplicate hash; units/frame; source part number and revision when stated.
alternatives: Keep external link only where local caching/redistribution terms are unclear.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Create immutable, rights-aware component records instead of treating catalogs as a common license.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Calculate or import physical mass properties
tools: CAD kernel mass properties; MuJoCo compiler geom inference; measured scale
prerequisites: Geometry scale/frame and density or measured mass stated; inertia reference frame defined.
preserves: Raw input values, source evidence, units and chosen frame.
changes_or_infers: Computes volume/COM/inertia from B-rep or mesh and density, or assigns measured values.
checks: Mass positive; tensor symmetric/positive-definite and triangle inequalities; compare independent mass where available; confirm mesh watertightness.
alternatives: Measured mass and center of gravity; manufacturer data; calculated mass with explicit density assumption.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Attach physical properties to the exact geometry revision and label calculation assumptions.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Author robot assembly from CAD component
tools: FreeCAD Assembly Workbench or explicit CAD assembly authoring
prerequisites: The brief states the component role, parent link, motion intent, axis and limits or records an ambiguity.
preserves: Source STEP/CAD identity, component placement evidence and units.
changes_or_infers: Authors assembly occurrence, frame and joint records from explicit requirements and measurements.
checks: Assembly placement and interfaces match measured controls; joint type/axis/limits are reviewed before export.
alternatives: For an existing assembly, use DOM-08 with authored joint-set.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Create a robot assembly occurrence and explicit joints from the sourced CAD component, stated role and measured interfaces; no joint type is inferred from mesh shape.

registered_operation_sequence.name: CAD assembly to articulated robot structure
tools: FreeCAD Assembly Workbench; explicit robot-description authoring; CAD-to-URDF scripts as candidates
prerequisites: Rigid link groups, parent-child relation, joint type, axis/frame/limits and fixed connections are explicit or reviewed.
preserves: CAD part IDs, geometry, named joint frames, source measurements and assembly transforms.
changes_or_infers: Groups occurrences into links; assembly constraints are mapped to robot joints; inferred joint types remain hypotheses.
checks: Graph connectivity, tree/loop identification, frame transforms, axis signs and limit source.
alternatives: Author URDF joint records directly; export FreeCAD Assembly4 through community script; inspect CAD_TO_URDF inferred tree.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Translate a mechanical assembly into explicit link and joint semantics; CAD hierarchy alone is insufficient.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Export mesh assets for MuJoCo
tools: CAD mesh exporter; Blender; Open CASCADE tessellation
prerequisites: Tessellation settings and mesh local frame/units chosen.
changes_or_infers: Surface geometry becomes triangles; MuJoCo supports OBJ and binary STL; material assignment is separate.
checks: Bounds, scale, normals, topology, source/mesh overlay and referenced geom role.
alternatives: MuJoCo primitives for simple geometry; custom decoder plugin for other asset formats.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Create simulation mesh files and retain their source frame and approximation settings.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Generate convex collision set
prerequisites: Input mesh local frame and scale known; collision features/contact regions identified.
preserves: Input visual mesh, source hash, license, decomposition parameters and derived hull set.
changes_or_infers: Nonconvex surface approximated by convex pieces; holes/passages may be filled or altered.
checks: Hull finite bounds; compare envelope/volume; inspect missing passages; simulator contact fixtures.
alternatives: Primitive colliders; single convex hull for coarse bounding; use original mesh only where supported and semantics understood.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Derive a collision-specific approximation and review topology-sensitive errors.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Robot assembly to URDF package
tools: URDF XML/Xacro authoring; ROS urdf_tutorial; CAD-to-URDF adapter proposal
prerequisites: Robot link/joint tree defined; mesh units and origins known; mass/inertia records have source and frame.
preserves: Part IDs, joint axes, limits, mesh lineage, mass/inertia provenance.
changes_or_infers: CAD links become URDF links; supported tree joints are mapped; CAD history/material layers may be omitted.
checks: Parse URDF; graph tree; positive mass and valid inertia; FK transforms; mesh path resolution and RViz/model consumer load.
alternatives: URDF for ROS ecosystem; direct MJCF for simulator-rich model.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Export a reviewed robot assembly into ROS link/joint XML and mesh assets.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Photos/video to camera solution, point cloud and mesh
prerequisites: Overlapping sharp views, camera metadata/calibration where available, scene motion/lighting assessed and scale controls identified.
preserves: Original frames, camera solution, control points, reconstruction settings, sparse/dense outputs.
changes_or_infers: Videos sampled into images; camera poses and dense surfaces are estimated from image correspondences.
checks: Registered-view coverage, reprojection residuals, independent scale distances, surface holes and withheld checks.
alternatives: RGB-D/LiDAR for metric depth; single-image learned mesh only for visual proposal.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Depth frames to registered point cloud or mesh
prerequisites: Sensor model, calibration, units, extrinsics and depth validity/range known.
preserves: Raw depth/color, frame timestamps, sensor coordinates and transforms.
changes_or_infers: Registration, filtering and surface fusion combine depth samples into new geometry.
checks: Loop closure, registration residual, independent lengths, depth noise and coverage.
alternatives: Photogrammetry for passive optical scenes; per-frame point cloud where fusion is inappropriate.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Fuse calibrated depth observations into metric geometry while retaining the raw sensor frames.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Dense multi-view stereo to point cloud and mesh

changes_or_infers: Estimates visible depth/surfaces and fuses points; mesh topology and texture are derived.
checks: Coverage, holes, reprojection, independent dimensions and surface residuals.
alternatives: Depth sensor integration via DOM-21; visual scene via DOM-22/30.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Point cloud to surface mesh
tools: Open3D surface reconstruction; CloudCompare mesh reconstruction; Blender mesh cleanup
prerequisites: Point cloud has known frame, scale, normals if required, and density/noise characteristics.
preserves: Input cloud, processing parameters, local frame and mesh lineage.
changes_or_infers: Interpolates surfaces between samples; fills and smooths gaps depending on method.
checks: Surface deviation to source cloud, holes, components, normals and over-smoothed features.
alternatives: Keep point cloud if no surface fill is justified; direct CAD remodeling via DOM-23.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Create a mesh surface from point samples and retain the interpolation as an inferred derivative.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Generate convex collision set
prerequisites: Input mesh local frame and scale known; collision features/contact regions identified.
preserves: Input visual mesh, source hash, license, decomposition parameters and derived hull set.
changes_or_infers: Nonconvex surface approximated by convex pieces; holes/passages may be filled or altered.
checks: Hull finite bounds; compare envelope/volume; inspect missing passages; simulator contact fixtures.
alternatives: Primitive colliders; single convex hull for coarse bounding; use original mesh only where supported and semantics understood.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Derive a collision-specific approximation and review topology-sensitive errors.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Add environment collision geometry to MJCF
tools: documented adapter or explicit authoring step
prerequisites: Source MJCF/environment frames are named; collision-set approximation and transform are recorded.
preserves: Robot body/joint graph and source scan/mesh.
changes_or_infers: Adds static environment geoms and collision pieces.
checks: Compile model; compare environment bounds and transforms; inspect passage openings and contact fixtures.
alternatives: Use primitives, analytic shapes or simulator-native geoms when the environment does not need mesh colliders.

steps.action: Extract a model brief from text and dimensions
human_interpretation: Identify each value as supplied, measured, inferred, assumed, or calculated.
Declare units, origin, axes, component boundaries, intended output and source links.
changes_or_infers: Groups explicit requirements into named parameters and geometry constraints.
Does not infer hidden geometry from prose alone.
checks: Every numerical parameter has units and provenance.
Ambiguities affecting geometry are listed separately.

steps.action: Read and clean vector drawing geometry
human_interpretation: Preserve source file and hash.
Determine drawing units, model/paper space, layer selection, block transforms, origin and target sketch plane.
Read DXF/SVG import option and unsupported entity behavior.
preserves: Entity types, layers, blocks, annotations and source coordinates where supported
changes_or_infers: Selects profile entities, normalizes transforms and may join, discretize, or repair curves.
checks: Count input/output entities by type and layer.
Find duplicate/open/self-intersecting edges.
Compare profile bounds, area and source dimensions.
For SVG, verify viewBox and physical scale; FreeCAD importer flattens Z.

steps.action: Build and constrain an editable planar sketch
tools: OpenCADStudio sketch/constraint capability as discovered in session
human_interpretation: Specify units, support plane and datum.
Resolve profile closure/repair and record which source curves changed.
Associate each dimensional constraint with measured/source/inferred status.
preserves: Constraint provenance in the project evidence ledger
changes_or_infers: Adds constraints and may alter underconstrained geometry to satisfy them.
checks: Solver state/degrees of freedom
Residuals and overconstraints
Source-to-constraint numeric comparison
Profile closedness and intersections

steps.action: Create a kernel solid and native model document from confirmed parameters
human_interpretation: Declare units, feature parameters, direction/axis and part boundary.
Use exact B-rep backend if exact surfaces/export are required.
Preserve native feature document or code source.
preserves: Native feature tree or executable parametric source
Editable native model document; feature history depends on the selected CAD application
changes_or_infers: Creates exact kernel geometry from the confirmed profile/feature instructions; unsupported features may require alternatives.
checks: Kernel shape validity and solid count
Bounds, volume, hole/shaft dimensions and units
Recompute or regenerate after one parameter change
Save/reopen and independent import

steps.action: Library asset intake and rights record
tools: component registry/schema proposal; source license review
human_interpretation: Original source identity and item-level license/terms available or explicitly unknown.
preserves: Original file, URL, retrieved date, hash, attribution, license text/terms and source claims.
changes_or_infers: Normalize metadata; derived conversions become separate assets with lineage.
checks: License status per file; duplicate hash; units/frame; source part number and revision when stated.

steps.action: Author robot assembly from CAD component
tools: FreeCAD Assembly Workbench or explicit CAD assembly authoring
human_interpretation: The brief states the component role, parent link, motion intent, axis and limits or records an ambiguity.
preserves: Source STEP/CAD identity, component placement evidence and units.
changes_or_infers: Authors assembly occurrence, frame and joint records from explicit requirements and measurements.
checks: Assembly placement and interfaces match measured controls; joint type/axis/limits are reviewed before export.

steps.action: Place reusable component in assembly
tools: OCS; FreeCAD Assembly Workbench; native CAD assembly API
human_interpretation: Component has named interface frames or measured mounting datums; target assembly frame known.
preserves: Component revision/hash, source frame and local geometry.
changes_or_infers: Adds occurrence transform and assembly connection relations.
checks: Interface transform consistency; interference; component identities and revision pins.

steps.action: Author assembly graph and joint set
tools: documented adapter or explicit authoring step
human_interpretation: Assembly part identities and placements exist; brief states intended motion or records unresolved motion questions.
preserves: Source CAD geometry and measured interface records.
changes_or_infers: Creates explicit graph and joint records; interpretation of motion intent remains reviewable.
checks: Each movable relation has parent/child, type, origin, axis, limits/units and source; graph topology is reported as tree or loop.

steps.action: CAD assembly to articulated robot structure
tools: FreeCAD Assembly Workbench; explicit robot-description authoring; CAD-to-URDF scripts as candidates
human_interpretation: Rigid link groups, parent-child relation, joint type, axis/frame/limits and fixed connections are explicit or reviewed.
preserves: CAD part IDs, geometry, named joint frames, source measurements and assembly transforms.
changes_or_infers: Groups occurrences into links; assembly constraints are mapped to robot joints; inferred joint types remain hypotheses.
checks: Graph connectivity, tree/loop identification, frame transforms, axis signs and limit source.

steps.action: Export mesh assets for MuJoCo
tools: CAD mesh exporter; Blender; Open CASCADE tessellation
human_interpretation: Tessellation settings and mesh local frame/units chosen.
changes_or_infers: Surface geometry becomes triangles; MuJoCo supports OBJ and binary STL; material assignment is separate.
checks: Bounds, scale, normals, topology, source/mesh overlay and referenced geom role.

steps.action: Generate convex collision set
human_interpretation: Input mesh local frame and scale known; collision features/contact regions identified.
preserves: Input visual mesh, source hash, license, decomposition parameters and derived hull set.
changes_or_infers: Nonconvex surface approximated by convex pieces; holes/passages may be filled or altered.
checks: Hull finite bounds; compare envelope/volume; inspect missing passages; simulator contact fixtures.

steps.action: Calculate or import physical mass properties
tools: CAD kernel mass properties; MuJoCo compiler geom inference; measured scale
human_interpretation: Geometry scale/frame and density or measured mass stated; inertia reference frame defined.
preserves: Raw input values, source evidence, units and chosen frame.
changes_or_infers: Computes volume/COM/inertia from B-rep or mesh and density, or assigns measured values.
checks: Mass positive; tensor symmetric/positive-definite and triangle inequalities; compare independent mass where available; confirm mesh watertightness.

steps.action: Author native MJCF simulation model
tools: MuJoCo MJCF XML and mjSpec API
human_interpretation: Consistent units chosen; body tree and element frames explicit; contact/actuation scope defined.
preserves: Editable XML/spec, mesh assets, frame definitions, physical-property provenance.
changes_or_infers: CAD components become bodies/geoms; density-based inertial calculation only where explicitly intended.
checks: MJCF schema/parser compile; inertia validity; joints, contact pairs, solver/actuator parameters and asset paths.

steps.action: Robot assembly to URDF package
tools: URDF XML/Xacro authoring; ROS urdf_tutorial; CAD-to-URDF adapter proposal
human_interpretation: Robot link/joint tree defined; mesh units and origins known; mass/inertia records have source and frame.
preserves: Part IDs, joint axes, limits, mesh lineage, mass/inertia provenance.
changes_or_infers: CAD links become URDF links; supported tree joints are mapped; CAD history/material layers may be omitted.
checks: Parse URDF; graph tree; positive mass and valid inertia; FK transforms; mesh path resolution and RViz/model consumer load.

code.entrypoint: Read DXF units/layers with ezdxf; use CadQuery importers.importDXF with explicit include layers and merge tolerance; select closed wires with wires().toPending(), apply confirmed scale and extrude with the required length. Inspect resulting topology and STEP readback. SVG uses the separately documented FreeCAD import route.

CadQuery Workplane sketch operations, extrude and cut; inspect Shape.isValid, BoundingBox and Volume; use STEP export and importers.importStep for exchange readback. Preserve Python parameters or native CAD construction intent separately.

MuJoCo MJCF body, joint, inertial, mesh and geom elements describe explicitly supplied frames, geometry and physical properties. MuJoCo MjModel.from_xml_path is the documented model compilation entry point.
Native application/API operations in the recorded recipe
code.role: Complete the remaining source-backed CAD, reconstruction, IFC or robot steps with their explicit human interpretation points.

outputs: Editable part/assembly with separate visual/collision derivatives and source-linked robot descriptions
Native/source artifacts and role-specific derivatives linked by source revision and hash.
checks: The brief defines rigid links and joint intent; geometry alone supplies no motion definition.
Interface frames bind component placement to named datums.
Mass properties are assigned per rigid body from recorded data or stated density/volume calculations.
URDF and MJCF are separate named derivatives of the same assembly revision.
Compare reference lengths with model coordinates in declared units; record residuals in mm separately for fit and check controls.
Inspect actual saved/imported geometry, component identities and source-to-output mapping.
failure_recovery: Return to the operation whose calibration, identity, geometry or interpretation check failed; preserve its inputs and previous outputs.
Resolve the affected source correspondence or feature meaning explicitly before regenerating downstream derivatives.

effort.human_reason: Associate drawing features, place components, define rigid bodies/joints and map physical properties.
effort.setup_reason: Connect CAD authoring, component registry, collision decomposition and robot description writers.
effort.compute_reason: CPU CAD and convex decomposition dominate; no image inference or training is part of this baseline.

resources.cpu: CAD construction, parsing, transforms, semantic authoring and validation run in their selected application/library processes.

resources.ram: Scales with images, points, triangles, CAD topology and retained representations. Record actual peak use during execution.
resources.storage: Preserve originals, native models, cameras/transforms, intermediate clouds/meshes and final derivatives separately.
scaling_drivers: Number of tool boundaries and evidence reconciliation steps
variants: Already calibrated/registered inputs reduce preparation work.
Pre-existing components with explicit interfaces reduce geometry authoring.
Large scenes or high-resolution images increase computing demand independently of manual effort.

tools: documented adapter or explicit authoring step
prerequisites: Assembly part identities and placements exist; brief states intended motion or records unresolved motion questions.
preserves: Source CAD geometry and measured interface records.
changes_or_infers: Creates explicit graph and joint records; interpretation of motion intent remains reviewable.
checks: Each movable relation has parent/child, type, origin, axis, limits/units and source; graph topology is reported as tree or loop.

registered_operation_sequence.name: CAD assembly to articulated robot structure
tools: FreeCAD Assembly Workbench; explicit robot-description authoring; CAD-to-URDF scripts as candidates
prerequisites: Rigid link groups, parent-child relation, joint type, axis/frame/limits and fixed connections are explicit or reviewed.
preserves: CAD part IDs, geometry, named joint frames, source measurements and assembly transforms.
changes_or_infers: Groups occurrences into links; assembly constraints are mapped to robot joints; inferred joint types remain hypotheses.
checks: Graph connectivity, tree/loop identification, frame transforms, axis signs and limit source.
alternatives: Author URDF joint records directly; export FreeCAD Assembly4 through community script; inspect CAD_TO_URDF inferred tree.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Translate a mechanical assembly into explicit link and joint semantics; CAD hierarchy alone is insufficient.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Export mesh assets for MuJoCo
tools: CAD mesh exporter; Blender; Open CASCADE tessellation
prerequisites: Tessellation settings and mesh local frame/units chosen.
changes_or_infers: Surface geometry becomes triangles; MuJoCo supports OBJ and binary STL; material assignment is separate.
checks: Bounds, scale, normals, topology, source/mesh overlay and referenced geom role.
alternatives: MuJoCo primitives for simple geometry; custom decoder plugin for other asset formats.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Create simulation mesh files and retain their source frame and approximation settings.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Generate convex collision set
prerequisites: Input mesh local frame and scale known; collision features/contact regions identified.
preserves: Input visual mesh, source hash, license, decomposition parameters and derived hull set.
changes_or_infers: Nonconvex surface approximated by convex pieces; holes/passages may be filled or altered.
checks: Hull finite bounds; compare envelope/volume; inspect missing passages; simulator contact fixtures.
alternatives: Primitive colliders; single convex hull for coarse bounding; use original mesh only where supported and semantics understood.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Derive a collision-specific approximation and review topology-sensitive errors.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Calculate or import physical mass properties
tools: CAD kernel mass properties; MuJoCo compiler geom inference; measured scale
prerequisites: Geometry scale/frame and density or measured mass stated; inertia reference frame defined.
preserves: Raw input values, source evidence, units and chosen frame.
changes_or_infers: Computes volume/COM/inertia from B-rep or mesh and density, or assigns measured values.
checks: Mass positive; tensor symmetric/positive-definite and triangle inequalities; compare independent mass where available; confirm mesh watertightness.
alternatives: Measured mass and center of gravity; manufacturer data; calculated mass with explicit density assumption.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Attach physical properties to the exact geometry revision and label calculation assumptions.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Author native MJCF simulation model
tools: MuJoCo MJCF XML and mjSpec API
prerequisites: Consistent units chosen; body tree and element frames explicit; contact/actuation scope defined.
preserves: Editable XML/spec, mesh assets, frame definitions, physical-property provenance.
changes_or_infers: CAD components become bodies/geoms; density-based inertial calculation only where explicitly intended.
checks: MJCF schema/parser compile; inertia validity; joints, contact pairs, solver/actuator parameters and asset paths.
alternatives: URDF import as a starting point; MuJoCo Menagerie as licensed model/reference.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Maintain a native MuJoCo XML/spec model with explicit simulation-only information.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Robot assembly to URDF package
tools: URDF XML/Xacro authoring; ROS urdf_tutorial; CAD-to-URDF adapter proposal
prerequisites: Robot link/joint tree defined; mesh units and origins known; mass/inertia records have source and frame.
preserves: Part IDs, joint axes, limits, mesh lineage, mass/inertia provenance.
changes_or_infers: CAD links become URDF links; supported tree joints are mapped; CAD history/material layers may be omitted.
checks: Parse URDF; graph tree; positive mass and valid inertia; FK transforms; mesh path resolution and RViz/model consumer load.
alternatives: URDF for ROS ecosystem; direct MJCF for simulator-rich model.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Export a reviewed robot assembly into ROS link/joint XML and mesh assets.

human_interpretation: Known target geometry and units

Undistorted images are derivatives
checks: Calibration reprojection RMS and per-image residuals
Undistort a held-out target image and compare straight edges

steps.action: Estimate camera poses and sparse structure from overlapping photos
human_interpretation: Static scene or moving objects masked
Overlap and texture sufficient for feature matching

preserves: Feature and match database, camera model, sparse reconstruction and settings

checks: Registered image fraction and component connectivity

steps.action: Build dense point cloud and mesh from SfM camera solution

checks: Image reprojection and dense coverage

checks: Plane/candidate feature residuals and inlier count
Repeat fit at alternative thresholds
Manual check for mixed surfaces and partial arcs

steps.action: Export mesh assets for MuJoCo
tools: CAD mesh exporter; Blender; Open CASCADE tessellation
human_interpretation: Tessellation settings and mesh local frame/units chosen.
changes_or_infers: Surface geometry becomes triangles; MuJoCo supports OBJ and binary STL; material assignment is separate.

steps.action: Generate convex collision set
human_interpretation: Input mesh local frame and scale known; collision features/contact regions identified.
preserves: Input visual mesh, source hash, license, decomposition parameters and derived hull set.
changes_or_infers: Nonconvex surface approximated by convex pieces; holes/passages may be filled or altered.
checks: Hull finite bounds; compare envelope/volume; inspect missing passages; simulator contact fixtures.

steps.action: Calculate or import physical mass properties
tools: CAD kernel mass properties; MuJoCo compiler geom inference; measured scale
human_interpretation: Geometry scale/frame and density or measured mass stated; inertia reference frame defined.
preserves: Raw input values, source evidence, units and chosen frame.
changes_or_infers: Computes volume/COM/inertia from B-rep or mesh and density, or assigns measured values.
checks: Mass positive; tensor symmetric/positive-definite and triangle inequalities; compare independent mass where available; confirm mesh watertightness.

steps.action: Author native MJCF simulation model
tools: MuJoCo MJCF XML and mjSpec API
human_interpretation: Consistent units chosen; body tree and element frames explicit; contact/actuation scope defined.
preserves: Editable XML/spec, mesh assets, frame definitions, physical-property provenance.
changes_or_infers: CAD components become bodies/geoms; density-based inertial calculation only where explicitly intended.
checks: MJCF schema/parser compile; inertia validity; joints, contact pairs, solver/actuator parameters and asset paths.

code.entrypoint: OpenCV findChessboardCornersSB, calibrateCamera and projectPoints: supply board object coordinates, detected image corners and image dimensions; retain intrinsics, distortion, poses and reprojection residuals.

Open3D registration_icp(source, target, max_correspondence_distance, init, estimation_method): provide source/target clouds in compatible units and a source-to-target initialization; inspect transformation, fitness and inlier_rmse.

CadQuery Workplane sketch operations, extrude and cut; inspect Shape.isValid, BoundingBox and Volume; use STEP export and importers.importStep for exchange readback. Preserve Python parameters or native CAD construction intent separately.

MuJoCo MJCF body, joint, inertial, mesh and geom elements describe explicitly supplied frames, geometry and physical properties. MuJoCo MjModel.from_xml_path is the documented model compilation entry point.
Native application/API operations in the recorded recipe

checks: Mass positive; tensor symmetric/positive-definite and triangle inequalities; compare independent mass where available; confirm mesh watertightness.
alternatives: Measured mass and center of gravity; manufacturer data; calculated mass with explicit density assumption.
registered_operation_sequence.summary: Attach physical properties to the exact geometry revision and label calculation assumptions.

registered_operation_sequence.name: Author native MJCF simulation model
tools: MuJoCo MJCF XML and mjSpec API
prerequisites: Consistent units chosen; body tree and element frames explicit; contact/actuation scope defined.

alternatives: URDF import as a starting point; MuJoCo Menagerie as licensed model/reference.

workflows.name: Calibrated photos and controls to editable CAD
workflows.output_scope: Metric-anchored camera solution, dense surface reference and constrained CAD interpretation.
workflows.comparison_conditions: Multi-view photos with adequate overlap and stable exposure; at least ten diverse calibration-target views if using the OpenCV calibration route; explicit scale/control measurements; dense MVS and selected OCS feature modeling.

inputs.format_and_quality: JPG/PNG originals with camera metadata; sharp overlapping views and visible calibration board in calibration subset.
JSON/CSV target dimensions and 3D control coordinates with units, plus named image-pixel correspondences or board measurements.
Text naming components, datums and intended CAD feature scope; it supplies semantics, not dimensions.

workflows.reference_points: Board corners: object coordinates in target frame and pixel detections. Calibration target establishes intrinsics and target-frame units; camera calibration alone does not scale the object capture. At least two separated measured scale/control distances are used to set/check reconstruction scale; reserve one or more controls from fitting. COLMAP adapter detail: OpenCV pixel-center principal point is shifted +0.5 px in x and y for COLMAP; OpenCV’s five coefficients [k1,k2,p1,p2,k3] map into COLMAP FULL_OPENCV [k1,k2,p1,p2,k3,k4,k5,k6] with the final three set to zero. Verify COLMAP camera database readback after feature extraction. COLMAP bundle adjustment refines parameters by default unless controlled; choose this based on calibration evidence.

software.role_and_api: meshroom_batch --input <image-folder> --output <output-folder> invokes the documented photogrammetry pipeline; `--save <project.mg>` persists the graph. This route manages its own graph and calibration; it does not consume the OpenCV calibration JSON adapter above.
software.dependencies: Meshroom/AliceVision bundled executable and pipeline resources; NVIDIA CUDA recommended for full reconstruction per official release notes.

steps.action: Calibrate the board-image subset with OpenCV calibrateCamera/projectPoints using the board inner-corner count, measured square size and unit; retain the per-image residuals.

Adapt the calibration JSON to COLMAP explicitly. For an OpenCV five-coefficient calibration result, use COLMAP FULL_OPENCV parameters [fx, fy, cx+0.5, cy+0.5, k1, k2, p1, p2, k3, 0, 0, 0]. The +0.5 shifts OpenCV pixel-center coordinates to COLMAP’s corner-based convention. Supply these during feature_extractor with --ImageReader.camera_model FULL_OPENCV --ImageReader.camera_params <comma-separated values> and --ImageReader.single_camera 1 only if every image has identical sensor/crop/focus settings. Read the stored camera back through pycolmap.Database.read_camera and compare width, height, model and every parameter before mapping; choose whether bundle adjustment may refine intrinsics. Never edit the binary SQLite camera parameter blob by hand.
Run COLMAP feature_extractor, matcher and mapper on the photo set, producing database.db and a sparse/0 camera model with sparse points.

Bridge the COLMAP sparse result to OpenMVS: run colmap image_undistorter --image_path <images> --input_path sparse/0 --output_path dense --output_type COLMAP, then InterfaceCOLMAP -i dense -o scene.mvs --image-folder dense/images. Run DensifyPointCloud scene.mvs and ReconstructMesh scene_dense.mvs. This explicit importer consumes undistorted images, sparse camera poses and sparse cloud.

Set the reconstruction’s metric frame/scale from distributed measured controls, reserve independent control lengths, then remodel selected features in OCS with dimensions labeled by evidence and read back the CAD revision.

code.entrypoint: OpenCV findChessboardCornersSB, calibrateCamera and projectPoints: supply board object coordinates, detected image corners and image dimensions; retain intrinsics, distortion, poses and reprojection residuals.

outputs.representation: Metric-anchored camera solution, dense surface reference and constrained CAD interpretation.
outputs.dimensional_status: Metric only where tied to explicit controls/sensor calibration; learned visual surfaces and view-synthesis products remain inferred or appearance representations.
outputs.editable_cad_dependency: OCS remodeling is a separate feature-interpretation stage requiring explicit dimensions, coordinate frame, constraints and readback.

workflows.checks: Pixel reprojection residuals; registered image fraction; withheld scale-control length error; mesh-to-cloud regional distances; OCS readback and independent feature dimensions. COLMAP camera DB readback: model name, image width/height and parameter values equal the adapter values after principal point conversion; verify whether bundle-adjustment refinement is enabled. Check COLMAP sparse reprojection and camera model before OpenMVS conversion.
workflows.failure_recovery: If calibration residuals cluster by image edge, verify lens/focus and corner detections; recapture target views if insufficient. If SfM separates into components, improve overlap/mask moving objects. If dense mesh is incomplete, adjust image coverage/lighting or use calibrated depth. If control residuals vary spatially, retain warp evidence and rebuild with more distributed controls rather than only uniform scale. If COLMAP intrinsics differ from calibration unexpectedly, inspect parameter ordering, OpenCV-to-COLMAP +0.5 px principal-point conversion, image resize/crop and bundle-adjustment refinement. Reinitialize the database with corrected feature_extractor options or use pycolmap.Database.update_camera, then read back the camera. If InterfaceCOLMAP rejects the scene, confirm image_undistorter produced COLMAP dense workspace with matching undistorted images and camera records.

inputs.format_and_quality: Original video with timestamps and camera metadata; sufficient parallax and sharp frames.

workflows.reference_points: Pixels map to normalized camera rays with K/distortion inverse, transformed into world by camera pose; ray intersection yields calculated 3D anchors against selected mesh. software.name: Nerfstudio Splatfacto/gsplat
software.role_and_api: ns-process-data, ns-train splatfacto, Gaussian PLY export

steps.action: Run COLMAP pose recovery or import the supplied camera solution and preserve image-to-camera mapping.

Train the Gaussian route with `ns-train splatfacto --data <processed-data>` and export its supported Gaussian PLY. The NeRF alternative uses `ns-train nerfacto --data <processed-data>` and keeps a separate checkpoint.
Inspect held-out novel views and preserve the checkpoint, processed transforms and original photo set. Any mesh must come from a separate documented geometry extraction step.
